task.title: Create an app bundle to deploy the web server
task.description:
Currently the web server is a local process a user runs. Create a build pipeline to bundle the server, including the sync watcher and any setup scripts, to deploy to a cloud hosting service, so that a team can share the service and see/interact without having to run the server locally/individually. Ideally target a couple of popular platforms like Cloudflare, Vercel, Render with clear deployment instructions.

Things we may need to also account for with this work:
 - Authentication/authorization
 - Automatic service restarts
 - The need for `git` and git authentication/PAT on deployment targets
